principles: Preserve existing whole-tree materialHash as provenance and strict fallback.
Add the smallest secondary signal needed to distinguish story-owned drift from unrelated repository drift.
Make downgraded whole-tree drift visible as an explicit warning, never a silent pass.
Keep freshness decisions mechanical and testable in gate code, not prompt prose.
drivers: Operators are repeatedly forced to refresh/revalidate after merging unrelated main changes.
Evidence freshness is gate-consumed and must remain sound for story-owned and transitive changes.
The change must integrate with review runs, verificationEvidence, and review escalation/fallback without broad lifecycle rewrites.

options.name: A: Secondary storyFilesHash plus warning-on-whole-tree-drift
pros: Separates story-owned file drift from unrelated repository drift while keeping materialHash recorded.
Allows existing strict materialHash checks to remain available for legacy/unsupported records.
Can be covered with focused smokes for unchanged story files vs changed story files.
cons: Requires threading a new optional field through several evidence and signature paths.
Needs careful warning language so users do not mistake advisory drift for full re-attestation.

options.name: B: Keep strict materialHash and rely on recover_evidence UX
pros: Smallest code change because recover_evidence already exists.
Conservatively fail-closed on any repository material drift.
cons: Does not solve the user pain; unrelated main merges still force refresh/revalidate.
Encourages mechanical busywork and hides the difference between story-owned and unrelated drift.

options.name: C: Replace materialHash with story diff only
pros: Directly avoids unrelated main drift noise.
Would be simple for operators to understand.
cons: Unsound for transitive dependencies and global gate facts that can affect the story without touching story-owned files.
Breaks existing Authority/review/evidence contracts that rely on materialHash provenance.

rationale: Option A solves the observed stale-noise problem while preserving strict materialHash as provenance and fallback; it is the only option that reduces unnecessary revalidation without weakening story-owned-file invalidation.

preMortem.scenario: storyFilesHash is computed over the wrong file set
preMortem.trigger: Using all changed files or metadata files instead of story-owned material files versus merge-base main
preMortem.consequence: Unrelated changes still stale evidence or story-owned changes are missed
preMortem.mitigation: Use existing diff/scope-contract helpers and add smoke cases for unrelated main changes and story-owned file changes.

preMortem.trigger: Freshness API returns only boolean true without carrying advisory drift details
preMortem.consequence: Users and gates cannot see that whole-tree materialHash drifted
preMortem.mitigation: Return structured warning/advisory reason and assert rendered output mentions re-attestation-required warning.

preMortem.scenario: Signature compatibility breaks old review runs
preMortem.trigger: Adding storyFilesHash unconditionally into signatures for records that did not have it
preMortem.mitigation: Make storyFilesHash optional and fold into signatures only when present, mirroring existing optional scope/workspace binding pattern.
